# PersePix (پرس‌پیکس)

> PersePix is an independent publishing house bringing contemporary Persian literature to European readers — in English and in bilingual editions.
>
> پرس‌پیکس ناشری مستقل است که ادبیات معاصر ایران را برای خوانندگان اروپایی می‌آورد — به انگلیسی و در نسخه‌های دوزبانه.

## Books (کتاب‌ها)

- [All books](http://localhost:3000/books): the complete published catalog.
- [Rust and Turquoise](http://localhost:3000/books/rust-and-turquoise)
- [The Cartographer of Silence](http://localhost:3000/books/the-cartographer-of-silence)
- [Songs for a Burnt Bridge](http://localhost:3000/books/songs-for-a-burnt-bridge)
- [The Archivist](http://localhost:3000/books/the-archivist)
- [The Orchard Keeper’s Daughter](http://localhost:3000/books/the-orchard-keepers-daughter)
- [The Nightingale’s Atlas](http://localhost:3000/books/the-nightingales-atlas)
- [Field Notes from the Alborz](http://localhost:3000/books/field-notes-from-the-alborz)
- [Tea at the Edge of Winter](http://localhost:3000/books/tea-at-the-edge-of-winter)
- [Letters to My City](http://localhost:3000/books/letters-to-my-city)
- [Blueprints of Exile](http://localhost:3000/books/blueprints-of-exile)
